note: A single injection of VSVΔG expressing the Andes virus glycoprotein precursor fully protected Syrian hamsters from a lethal Andes virus challenge.
The Andes virus glycoprotein vaccine generated neutralizing antibodies in Syrian hamsters when given 28 days before challenge.
A single intraperitoneal dose of rVSV-HTNV-GP elicited Hantaan virus neutralizing antibodies in BALB/c mice.
